title: Colimits, tensor products and internal homs of quasi-coherent sheaves on the big site
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects three compatibility statements for the category of quasi-coherent sheaves on (Sch/S)_fppf: colimits exist and agree with those computed in the Zariski, etale and fppf module categories (1), tensor products agree and stay quasi-coherent (2), and internal homs of a finite locally free sheaf agree and stay quasi-coherent (3) (statement lines 3614-3638). The proof is carried out part by part: the common input is that the equivalence QCoh(O_S) -> QCoh((Sch/S)_tau, O), F -> F^a, has the same formula for every topology tau; part (1) writes a diagram as G_i^a and pushes the colimit through the equivalence using the limits lemma; part (2) does the same for the tensor product; part (3) first records the chain of equivalences making 'finite locally free' topology-independent, via the corresponding property lemma, and then observes that the construction of the internal hom in Modules on Sites depends only on the underlying presheaves of modules, so the output agrees across topologies (proof lines 3640-3701). The level is H3: three independent parts, each with its own reduction displayed, and the only quoted ingredients are general results about the equivalence and the internal hom construction.
